# CivicEye

> > CivicEye is a comprehensive criminal justice software platform providing integrated records management, case management, and digital evidence solutions for law enforcement, prosecutors, and courts.

CivicEye delivers full-spectrum criminal justice technology built on cloud infrastructure with CJIS compliance, CAD integration, and partnerships with leading public safety vendors like AWS, Zetron, and Frontline. The platform serves police departments, sheriff offices, district attorneys, and court systems across the United States.

## Key Topics

- CivicRMS

## Core Products

- [CivicRMS - Records Management System](https://www.civiceye.com/products/civicrms): CivicRMS records management system for law enforcement with CAD integration
- [CivicDocs - Digital Evidence Management](https://www.civiceye.com/products/civicdocs): CivicDocs cloud-based digital evidence and document management solution
- [CivicCase - Prosecutor Case Management](https://www.civiceye.com/products/civiccase): CivicCase prosecutor case management solution with CJIS compliance
- [CivicCase for Court](https://www.civiceye.com/products/civiccase-for-court): CivicCase for Court streamlines court operations and docket management
- [Products Overview](https://www.civiceye.com/products): CivicEye product overview: CivicRMS, CivicDocs, CivicCase for prosecutors/courts

## Solutions by Role

- [Law Enforcement Solutions](https://www.civiceye.com/who-we-serve/law-enforcement): CivicEye solutions for police departments, sheriff offices, school security
- [Prosecutor Solutions](https://www.civiceye.com/who-we-serve/prosecutors): CivicEye case management and evidence handling for district attorneys
